title: A listed request that answers non-2xx is excused when Jellyfin gives the same status
notes: The criterion says each listed request must answer 2xx and never 404. sweep() skips a failure when `reference.answers(r, status)` returns true, meaning Jellyfin answered the same status. A route that 404s on both servers (for example because of a fixture id mismatch) is excused, and the schema check never sees its answer. Closed by the product owner: duplicate of BL-072.
